parsed.post: Significant win! Experiment with DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.02 (with original batch 524288 and warmup 0.05) achieved 1.007779. While the 0.02 probe was previously discarded at batch 524288 (1.042), increasing DEPTH to 6 appears to mitigate that regression. Next: stacking the proven 2x-steps win (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) on this DEPTH=6/LR=0.02 stack.
parsed.description: Stacking TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 on the new DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.02 configuration to see if more steps allow the lower learning rate to converge better.
